text:
Priya: Quick sync on Permissions UI + RBAC for Console. Key decisions: roles vs scopes, enterprise features (SSO group mapping, audit logs, SCIM), and how this plugs into our internal auth API. TL;DR: we need composable roles, a custom-role editor, and a rollout plan that won't spike Console latency.
Diego: +1 to composable roles. Proposal: three opinionated baseline roles (viewer/editor/admin) and then scope buckets you can attach: project.*, model.*, route.*. UI should let admins create "role templates" by selecting scopes.
Ava: UX notes: show an "effective permissions" preview so admins can test a user against a given role combo before saving. Also need searchable scopes in the editor and a compact multiselect UI.
Jamal: Perf caveat: per-request permission checks will kill list endpoints without caching. We should expose a batch-check endpoint on the auth service: POST /v1/perm/batch-check with payload of {principal, actions[], resources[]}, return allowed[] booleans. Cache results per principal|org|resource_namespace. Invalidate on role/group changes.
Priya: Jamal, what's a safe cache TTL? And invalidation trigger?
Jamal: Start with 60s TTL for Console views. Critical: publish events (auth.role.updated, auth.saml.mapping.updated, scim.sync.completed) to event bus and have auth-cache-subsystem subscribe and evict keys. Immediate invalidation on role mutation for that org.
Maria: Enterprise reqs: SAML group -> role mapping + an override UI so org admins can remap. SCIM should be able to sync groups and map to roles automatically. Audit logs must capture who changed role mappings and show before/after diffs. Also: role binding history retention configurable for compliance.
Priya: How do we represent role bindings in our internal model? Flat role assignments, or role bindings with scope constraints?
Diego: Use role bindings: {principal_id, role_id, resource_selector}. resource_selector can be "org/*", "project:proj-123", "model:ml-xyz". That lets roles be reusable.
Ava: In the UI show two modes: "global role" and "scoped role binding". Default to scoped for safety. Add a clear warning when granting admin at org level.
Priya: Internal API debate: REST endpoints vs GraphQL for permission checks and role config. Thoughts?
Jamal: For performance and simplicity, keep a small REST surface for the auth checks (batch-check, who-has-perm, list-bindings) and use an internal RPC/gRPC for internal services. GraphQL is nice for the Console UI but introduces N+1 if not careful. If Console needs complex joins, add a single server-side resolver that folds multiple calls into one batch-check backend call.
Diego: Also need CLI/infra support: rbac inspect --principal <id> --org <org> to print effective roles and bound scopes. Useful for SRE.
Maria: Ent-only controls: allow org-level lock-down so only super-admins can create custom roles or change SAML mappings. Feature flag this behind "rbac-enterprise-controls".
deploy-bot: feature-flag "rbac-console-v2" created; rollout plan: 10% orgs -> 25% -> 100% after metrics look good.
Priya: Migration plan for existing customers: existing role assignments (old boolean flags) should be migrated into default role templates. We need a dry-run migration tool that lists changes and lets org admins approve. Also surface any principals that lose access.
Ava: For the Console, we should add a "Preview as user" button on pages so admins can see the UI as that user sees it (hide controls they can't access).
Jamal: Security/ops: ensure permission check calls are authenticated with mTLS when called from runtime services. Console -> auth service can use internal service token. Cache at the Console instance level to avoid double hops.
Priya: What about auditing permission evaluation calls? We will log allow/deny for critical actions (create-dedicated, update-saml, delete-route) with request id. Keep sampling for high-volume actions.
Diego: One more: scoped API keys. We need to support API keys that are bound to roles/scopes and show them in the Console with expiration and last-used. Keys tied to service principals should inherit bindings.
Maria: Compliance: add exportable audit reports (CSV) for role changes and SCIM sync events. Retention configurable per-enterprise tier.
Priya: Ok action items: 1) Jamal/Diego: design auth batch-check endpoint + cache invalidation events. 2) Ava: mocks for role template editor + preview-as-user flows. 3) Maria: enterprise controls list + SAML/SCIM mapping UI text. 4) Diego: CLI inspect command design + API key UI. 5) Priya: migration dry-run spec. We'll sync again after initial PRs.
Diego: I'll start a PR for the batch endpoint and event emitter. Will include perf tests for Console list scenarios.
Jamal: I'll work on the cache component and invalidation subscriber. Also add metrics: cache hit ratio, avg check latency.
Ava: Mock branch incoming later today.
Priya: Thanks all. Ping me on thread for any blockers. :raised_hands:
